summary: Set node_type per host or in a group's vars: hybrid (default) or control in [automationcontroller], execution (default) or hop in [execution_nodes]; containerized installs use receptor_type instead.
questions: How do I define a hop node in the inventory?
How do I make all controller nodes control nodes?

answer_card.title: Set automation mesh node types
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationcontroller]
control-plane-1.example.com node_type=control   # or hybrid (default)

[execution_nodes]
execution-plane-1.example.com node_type=hop      # or execution (default)
execution-plane-2.example.com
```
For a whole group use `[automationcontroller:vars]` with `node_type=control`. Containerized installs use `receptor_type` instead of `node_type`.
